title: Goals
subtitle: Pick a number, then add to it bit by bit.

card.requiredNone: No deadline, so no monthly amount yet.

empty.title: No goals yet
empty.hint: Think of something you want to save for: an emergency fund, a laptop, a year-end trip. We will work out how much to set aside each month.

error.title: Could not load goals
error.hint: The connection may be unstable. Please try again.

form.name: Goal name
form.deadlineHint: With a deadline we can work out what to save each month.
form.nameRequired: Please give your goal a name.
form.targetBelowSaved: The target should not be lower than what you have saved.

contribute.title: Add or withdraw
contribute.tooMuch: You can withdraw at most what you have saved.
contribute.errTooMuch: That is more than you have saved in this goal. Lower the amount and try again.
contribute.errClosed: This goal is canceled, so it cannot take new contributions. Reopen it first.
contribute.note2: This only records the amount in the goal. It does not change your wallet balance.

detail.notFound: We could not find this goal
detail.historyEmptyHint: Your first contribution will show up here with its date.
detail.achievedInfo: Achieved because what you saved reached the target. If you withdraw some, the status updates by itself.
detail.canceledInfo: Canceled: no new contributions. What you saved is kept.
detail.historyUnavailableHint: The server doesn't keep individual contributions yet. The saved total above is correct.

delete.title: Delete goal “{{name}}”?
delete.body: The goal and its history will be removed. This cannot be undone. To just pause it, choose Cancel goal instead.

cancel.title: Cancel goal “{{name}}”?
cancel.body: It stops taking new contributions and sending reminders. You can reopen it any time. What you saved is kept.

celebrate.title: You reached “{{name}}”!
celebrate.body: Every contribution counted. Congratulations on getting all the way there.
